title: Artwork above, responsive W below
slide_intent: Let the artwork determine the remaining identity space because a consistent brand need not force every image into one crop.
strategic_value: The adaptable W can preserve Whitney recognition while respecting the proportions of an exhibition image.
demonstration: A vertical preliminary layout places a widescreen 20th Century Fox image above a tall W in the remaining white area.
practical_value: Fit the mark to the space remaining around an image rather than distorting the image to fit a fixed logo panel.

content_islands.name: Artwork
content_islands.spec: Place the horizontal artwork reproduction across the upper portion of the portrait frame.

content_islands.name: Remaining space
content_islands.spec: Extend the W through the tall white area beneath the artwork.

reference_purposes.Intent: The adjacent essay says the W makes the remaining space visible and expresses the primacy of the artwork.
reference_purposes.Application: The preliminary sketch demonstrates fitting the identity into the space left by a horizontal artwork.

ingredient.name: Responsive W around artwork
ingredient.role: Identify the institution in the space left by the artwork.
ingredient.application: Let the artwork retain its proportions and adapt the W to the remaining area.
ingredient.scope: 2012 preliminary composition and accompanying 2013 essay; the shape shown is one example, not a fixed template.
